description: iSpot Unified Measurement impression GIFs on pi.ispot.tv/v2, whose client tracking code rides in the path as TC-####-#. TV conversion GIFs on pt.ispot.tv are vendor/ispot-conversion.

params.name: tracking_code
params.description: It is the client-specific tracking code. iSpot documents the impression pixel path as /v2/TC-####-#.gif.
params.fix_hint: Put the tracking code from iSpot in the path so it reads /v2/TC-{account}-{pixel}.gif.

params.name: campaignid
params.description: iSpot documents campaignid as a string with at most 64 characters.

params.name: channel
params.description: iSpot documents channel as a string with at most 16 characters.

params.name: cid
params.description: iSpot documents cid as a string with at most 128 characters.

params.name: creativeid
params.description: iSpot documents creativeid as a string with at most 64 characters.

params.name: creativename
params.description: iSpot documents creativename as a string with at most 64 characters.

params.name: customdata
params.description: iSpot documents customdata as a string with at most 256 characters.

params.name: devicetype
params.description: iSpot documents devicetype as a string with at most 16 characters.

params.name: placementid
params.description: iSpot documents placementid as a string with at most 64 characters. Required for the documented reporting contract; the guide also permits a bare base pixel.

params.name: placementtype
params.description: iSpot documents placementtype as a string with at most 32 characters.

params.name: platform
params.description: iSpot documents platform as a string with at most 7 characters. Required for the documented reporting contract; the guide also permits a bare base pixel.

params.name: publisher
params.description: iSpot documents publisher as a string with at most 64 characters. Required for the documented reporting contract; the guide also permits a bare base pixel.

params.name: segment
params.description: iSpot documents segment as a string with at most 128 characters.
